meta.description: Synthetic demo data for Sentinel Access, derived from hardcoded frontend fixtures (client/src/pages/Home.tsx and client/src/components/WorkspaceViews.tsx). All identities, addresses, IPs, event volumes, and locations are fictitious and safe for public/hackathon demo use.

alerts.title: Impossible travel + privilege pivot
alerts.description: A privileged console session originated from a new anonymizing network shortly after a successful session in Singapore.
alerts.baseline: Aisha typically signs in from Singapore on weekdays between 08:00-19:00 UTC and has not used this ASN in the past 90 days.
alerts.recommended: Require step-up authentication and review the created access key before allowing further privilege changes.

alerts.title: Unusual bulk secret retrieval
alerts.description: The deployment identity read 28 secrets outside its normal release window.
alerts.baseline: This workload normally retrieves 4-6 scoped secrets only during the 02:00 UTC release window.
alerts.recommended: Compare the task definition with the latest approved deployment and rotate any unneeded credentials.

alerts.title: Dormant account reactivated
alerts.description: An account inactive for 63 days signed in and enumerated production storage containers.
alerts.baseline: Noah's identity has no recorded activity since the contractor offboarding review in June.
alerts.recommended: Validate current employment status and terminate active refresh tokens if access is no longer required.

alerts.title: New API geography
alerts.description: A personal access token performed repository administration from an unseen country.
alerts.baseline: Maya's prior 30-day access is limited to London and Amsterdam through managed devices.
alerts.recommended: Confirm travel, inspect the token's scope, and revoke it if it was not intentionally used.

alerts.title: Policy edit outside change window
alerts.description: An S3 bucket policy change was performed shortly after a denied service-control-policy action.
alerts.baseline: Samir's policy changes usually occur through CI with linked change records, not the console.
alerts.recommended: Compare the policy version with the approved infrastructure-as-code change and document the exception.

modelRationale.explanation: The strongest signal is not a single unusual event. It is the sequence: an unfamiliar network, an impossible geography transition, and an immediate privilege change.
